hypothesis: Forcing Gemini CLI's encrypted file backend into the invocation-isolated home and rejecting either supported API-based authentication-selection shape before spawn will prevent macOS Keychain entries from authenticating KOTA native harness runs while preserving unauthenticated boundary diagnostics.

metricsCompared.name: Keychain-backed API-key launch admission
metricsCompared.baseline: Gemini CLI could preserve its API-based authentication type and consult the macOS system Keychain after KOTA's known-file checks passed.
metricsCompared.candidate: Both supported API-auth selection shapes are rejected before spawn, GEMINI_FORCE_FILE_STORAGE is overwritten to true, and Gemini receives only invocation-scoped home directories.

metricsCompared.name: Authentication-boundary regression coverage
metricsCompared.baseline: No readiness, runtime-home, passive-loop, or autonomous-loop regression exercised a possible Keychain-backed Gemini API-key selection.
metricsCompared.candidate: The focused Gemini runtime, readiness, adapter, and strict-type suite passes 33 tests, including passive and autonomous no-spawn assertions for both authentication-selection shapes.
metricsCompared.unit: focused passing tests and covered launch modes

metricsCompared.name: Unrelated CLI help stability
metricsCompared.baseline: The broad repair run reported two help-command failures under suite load: one 30-second subprocess timeout and one empty stdout result.
metricsCompared.candidate: The two affected CLI test files pass 38 of 38 tests when rerun together in isolation without any CLI source change.

rationale: The candidate closes a confirmed high-severity provider-authentication boundary bypass by making authentication denial stricter; it grants no provider auth-material access, tool authority, network access, or write scope. Focused code, type, build, format, and CLI rerun evidence passes. The existing provider-auth broker remains unavailable, so authenticated native runs continue to fail closed while unauthenticated boundary diagnostics remain available.
